question: What claim of transmission is made by stating that the practice of the soul has been told to the addressed one?
premises: This practice of the soul is indicated.
It has been told to you.
The statement is repeated for emphasis to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The agent of telling is not specified by this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you again, O Bhairavī.
